title: Cookies & Cream cake near Guildford or Auburn? 100% eggless, Harris Park
summary:
Looking for a Cookies & Cream cake near Guildford or Auburn that has no eggs in it at all?

Every cake we bake in Harris Park is 100% eggless. Not a few flavours. All 15, Cookies & Cream included. The base is oil, not butter, which is why the sponge stays soft a day or two after pickup.

Order two days ahead and collect from Shop 1, 96-98 Wigram Street, any time from 11am to 10pm. That suits anyone driving in from Granville, Westmead or Parramatta after work.

It's a Cookies & Cream cake. It also happens to be eggless.
